thread-1.subject: School fair volunteering rota
thread-1.snippet: You're down to organize the bake sale stall for the September fair.

messages.snippet: You're down to organize the bake sale stall for the September fair.
messages.body:
Hi Dan,

Thanks for volunteering! You're down to organize the bake sale stall for the school fair on 19 September. That means recruiting 3-4 parent helpers, arranging who bakes what, sorting a float for the cash box, and picking up the table from the caretaker the day before.

No rush to reply -- just make sure it's all sorted by early September.

Best,
Lakeside PTA
